h1: Do ADUs in Newton need separate water, sewer, and electric meters?
title: Newton ADU Utility Connections: Water, Sewer and Electric Services
description: Learn which Newton utility office handles new water service and which meter and connection questions still need direct confirmation.
short_answer: The official sources reviewed do not establish a universal requirement for every Newton ADU to have separate water, sewer, or electric meters. Newton's Utilities Division handles water-service applications and prepares a project-specific cost estimate for new water service. Confirm meter, sewer, and electrical-service requirements for the particular ADU before construction.

facts.text: Newton requires a water-service application for a new water service, after which the Utilities Division prepares a cost estimate for the work described by the City.
Newton ISD administers separate plumbing, gas, and electrical trade permits where that work requires a permit.

qa.q: Must every ADU have its own water meter?
qa.a: The reviewed official sources do not establish a universal separate-meter rule. Ask Newton Utilities and ISD about the proposed unit and existing service configuration.
